Adapted from [Best Mashed Potatoes](https://natashaskitchen.com/creamy-mashed-potatoes-recipe/) by Natasha Kravchuk, Natasha's Kitchen.

**Yield:** 10 servings · **Prep:** 15 min · **Cook:** 25 min

## Ingredients

- 4 lb russet potatoes (about 12 medium), peeled
- 1 to 1 ¼ cups hot milk (the source uses whole milk)
- 16 tablespoons (2 sticks) unsalted butter, at room temperature, not melted
- 1 ½ teaspoons salt, or to taste
- 1 tablespoon fresh parsley or chives, finely chopped, to garnish (optional)

## Method

1. Put the peeled potatoes in a large pot (5 quarts or more), halving any very large ones, and cover with cold water.
2. Bring to a boil and cook 20 to 25 minutes, until a knife goes in easily.
3. Drain well and move the potatoes to the bowl of a stand mixer.
4. Mix with the whisk on low for 30 seconds, then raise the speed and pour in the hot milk slowly until the texture is right.
5. With the mixer running, add the butter 1 tablespoon at a time, waiting a few seconds between each.
6. When the mash is light and fluffy, season with the salt. Garnish with the parsley or chives.

## Notes

- A potato ricer or a hand masher works in place of the mixer.
- Make ahead up to 1 day and refrigerate. Keep warm up to 1 hour over simmering water or in a 200°F oven, or up to 3 hours in a slow cooker on low, stirring every 30 minutes.
- Keeps 3 to 4 days in the fridge in an airtight container, or up to 1 month frozen; thaw overnight in the fridge.
